transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function using explicit `slice: &mut [MaybeUninit<T>]` and `src: &[T]` parameters plus the generated ensures clauses. The public target is not external_body and contains no assume_specification.

Preserved the Rust 1.96 length assertion and equal-length `let len = self.len(); let src = &src[..len];` source-prefix step. The harness-local `rust_1_96_equal_len_source_prefix` helper is now executable and proves the full-prefix view via the source-equivalent `split_at(len)` construction under `len == src@.len()` instead of using a target-local `external_body` boundary.

Preserved the Guard initialization counter, length-indexed clone/write loop, `guard.initialized += 1`, and final `forget(guard)` control flow. The per-iteration wrapper executes the source-side `src[i].clone()` after proving `i < src@.len()`, calls the lower retained `rust_1_96_write_cloned_at` boundary only for the destination `slice[i].write(value)` MaybeUninit slot write, then records one-step MaybeUninit prefix initialization through the retained `rust_1_96_write_clone_iteration_effect` bridge. The loop invariant carries that prefix fact to the final written-from relation.

Reused the audited MaybeUninit relation vocabulary and the ordered `core::slice::assume_init_mut` dependency shape for the final initialized-storage cast. Proof-only loop invariants, the per-iteration prefix bridge, and the final complete-prefix lemma expose the generated MaybeUninit written-from relation without changing executable control flow.
